API

For AI agents: this API as Markdown, or every component in llms-full.txt.

<ray-popover> · RayPopover

Positioned in JS (flip + shift to stay in the viewport). JS: show(), hide(), toggle().

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
openopen reflectsbooleanShown.
placementplacement reflectsbottom | bottom-start | bottom-end | top | top-start | top-end | left | left-start | left-end | right | right-start | right-endbottomPreferred side and alignment.
offsetoffsetnumber8Gap to the trigger in px.
widthwidthstringPanel width (px number or CSS length). Default: its content.
matchWidthmatch-widthbooleanAt least as wide as the trigger.
paddingpadding reflects0 | xs | sm | md | lgmdPanel padding.
trapFocustrap-focusbooleanMoves focus into the panel when opened and keeps Tab inside it.
EventDescription
ray-openAfter it opened.
ray-closeAfter it closed (also by Escape or an outside click).
SlotDescription
triggerThe element that toggles it (gets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded).
(default)Panel content.
PartDescription
dropdownThe panel.
